digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate - necessity probe and bug review tier
propositions: FixedBench detects over-action (unnecessary mechanism addition) but plan-review gate has no corresponding criterion to flag when a proposed change lacks demonstrated need or motivation

Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS in plan-review gate via orchestrator._exempt_verdict, receiving no substantive review (verified: bug 5886 persisted REVIEW_RESULT with llm_calls:0)

A new single-turn advisory criterion necessity must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing current-behavior reproduction or motivation, while accepting justified no-op and well-motivated outcomes
Bug tickets must stop gate-exempting and instead receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of DET floor and the necessity probe only, never blocking

The necessity criterion must be registered in criteria_routing.json with exec:1-TURN, facet:scope-intent, default_posture:advisory, block_threshold:0.95, applies_at.scope:[leaf], and deliberately no suppress_types so it applies to bugs

Post-ship promotion from advisory to blocking is dogfood-gated on standing effectiveness recorder metrics, not config flags, requiring operator attestation of landing via Gerrit change with both CI and LLM-Review votes
